typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		event_date as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		toolset as string,
		ins_type as string,
		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		internal_external as string,
		type_of_event as string,
		trade_time as string,
		trader_name as string,
		executed_by as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		trade_event_category as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		booked_to_new_by as string,
		new_validated_by as string,
		tran_num as string,
		sql_date as string,
		latest_validated_by as string,
		Cancelled_by as string,
		amend_reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DailyTradeEventsReportCancelled
DailyTradeEventsReportCancelled derive(FileName = toString($sFilename),
		LoadDate_drv = toString(currentTimestamp()),
		amend_reason_der = toString(replace(amend_reason, toString('\"'), toString('')))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of trader_name} = trader_name,
		{Copy of deal_tracking_num} = deal_tracking_num) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		trade_event_category as string,
		toolset as string,
		Internal_External as string,
		executed_by as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		trade_time as string,
		booked_to_new_by as string,
		Date_Updated as string,
		FileName as string,
		new_validated_by as string,
		amend_reason as string,
		Cancelled_by as string,
		type_of_event as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		latest_validated_by as string,
		event_date as string,
		insType as string,
		name as string,
		trader_name as string,
		short_name as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		tran_num as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		trade_event_category,
		toolset,
		Internal_External = internal_external,
		executed_by,
		deal_tracking_num,
		trade_time,
		booked_to_new_by,
		Date_Updated = LoadDate_drv,
		FileName,
		new_validated_by,
		amend_reason = amend_reason_der,
		Cancelled_by,
		type_of_event,
		marketer_name,
		latest_validated_by,
		event_date,
		insType = ins_type,
		name,
		trader_name,
		short_name,
		action_interval_days,
		tran_num),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledStaging
